name: speed-ab-merge3b
command: for r in 1 2 3; do for b in fast merge3; do for S in "" "--spec 3 --draft-vocab 32768"; do echo "RESULT {\"bin\":\"$b\",\"round\":$r}"; ./engine/pinfer_run_$b -m models/qwen35-0.8b-q4k-headq4k.pq -t 4 -n 64 --ids-file data/prompt64.ids --bench $S | grep "^RESULT"; done; done; done
